_meta.schema_note: dd_type here conflates two independent axes; the consuming schema splits it into hwm_basis (ratchet cadence) and breach_basis (what is tested against the floor). TPT = breach_basis:intraday_equity_incl_unrealized in ALL phases; hwm_basis eod_close for Test and PRO+, intraday_equity for PRO.

_meta.note: PRO = funded SIM with real payouts. PRO+ = live. Drawdown BREACH is checked realtime including unrealized P&L in every phase; only the TRAILING cadence differs by phase.

development._variant_note: NOT A PURCHASABLE ACCOUNT. The Development account is TPT's risk-remediation placement: traders are MOVED here at the firm's discretion for 'aggressive sizing, rapid drawdowns, blown loss limits, reckless risk management', and exit after roughly 60 days of disciplined trading with no profit number required. It is tighter than PRO+ on purpose -- on a 50K, max_dd 1250 against 2000 and 2 contracts against 6, plus a soft DLL that PRO+ does not have. Kept in the table because a trader sitting in one needs it modelled, but any UI that offers it beside the plans a trader can BUY is telling them something false: TPT sells one account, in sizes, with phases Test -> PRO -> PRO+.
